text: Create an epic cinematic poster in the style of a dark fantasy with double exposure, evoking memories: a huge blonde female warrior or goddess fills the entire composition from the upper left to the lower right corner, she stands facing the camera and her long hair, fluttering in the wind, flows through the fiery sky. Inside her image, a muscular barbarian hero with long dark hair rushes forward through splashing water and debris from the battlefield, holding a sword in his right hand and a round shield in his left. Surround your hero in a massive medieval battle: armies with spears and banners, ruined Gothic castles, jagged mountains, flying dragons or large birds, smoke, sparks and silhouettes of soldiers. Effectively divide the lighting into two opposite color worlds: icy-blue thunderclouds and cold fog on the left, a blazing orange-red sunset, fire and smoldering coals on the right. In the foreground, there are huge figures in dark armor and shields curving upward from both lower corners, including an armored limb or glove, highlighted in red, on the right, and a metal shield-like structure, highlighted in blue, on the left, framing the attacking hero. Use over-detailed fantasy realism, high contrast, extreme motion dynamics, voluminous clouds, splashes of rain, flaming horizon at sunset, cinematic concept art, complex armor textures, chaotic atmosphere of war, vertical poster composition. Make the central character a barbarian warrior, the giant figure a blonde female warrior goddess, the left palette an icy blue storm, and the right a fiery orange-red sunset.
